statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Request-URI of the request contains an maddr parameter, the Request-URI MUST be placed into the target set as the only target URI, and the proxy MUST proceed to Section 16.6.
actions: Place Request-URI into target set as the only target URI

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Request-URI of the request contains an maddr parameter, the Request-URI MUST be placed into the target set as the only target URI, and the proxy MUST proceed to Section 16.6.
statements.trigger: Request-URI contains maddr parameter & target set populated with Request-URI

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the domain of the Request-URI indicates a domain this element is not responsible for, the Request-URI MUST be placed into the target set as the only target, and the element MUST proceed to the task of Request Forwarding (Section 16.6).
statements.trigger: Request-URI domain not this element's responsibility
actions: Place Request-URI into target set as the only target

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the domain of the Request-URI indicates a domain this element is not responsible for, the Request-URI MUST be placed into the target set as the only target, and the element MUST proceed to the task of Request Forwarding (Section 16.6).
statements.trigger: Request-URI domain not this element's responsibility & target set populated with Request-URI
actions: Proceed to the task of Request Forwarding (Section 16.6)

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the target set for the request has not been predetermined as described above, this implies that the element is responsible for the domain in the Request-URI, and the element MAY use whatever mechanism it desires to determine where to send the request.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When accessing the location service constructed by a registrar, the Request-URI MUST first be canonicalized as described in Section 10.3 before being used as an index.
statements.trigger: accessing location service constructed by registrar
actions: Canonicalize Request-URI as described in Section 10.3 before using as index

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Request-URI does not provide sufficient information for the proxy to determine the target set, it SHOULD return a 485 (Ambiguous) response.
statements.trigger: Request-URI insufficient to determine target set

statements.subject: message
statements.description: This response SHOULD contain a Contact header field containing URIs of new addresses to be tried.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Any information in or about the request or the current environment of the element MAY be used in the construction of the target set.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a target URI is already present in the set (based on the definition of equality for the URI type), it MUST NOT be added again.
statements.trigger: candidate target URI matches existing entry in target set

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A proxy MUST NOT add additional targets to the target set if the Request-URI of the original request does not indicate a resource this proxy is responsible for.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Request-URI of the original request indicates a resource this proxy is responsible for, the proxy MAY continue to add targets to the set after beginning Request Forwarding.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: It MAY use any information obtained during that processing to determine new targets.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a proxy uses a dynamic source of information while building the target set (for instance, if it consults a SIP Registrar), it SHOULD monitor that source for the duration of processing the request.
statements.trigger: proxy uses dynamic source while building target set
actions: Monitor dynamic information source for the duration of processing the request

statements.subject: server
statements.description: New locations SHOULD be added to the target set as they become available.
statements.trigger: new location becomes available from dynamic source
actions: Add new location to target set as it becomes available

statements.subject: server
statements.description: As above, any given URI MUST NOT be added to the set more than once.
statements.trigger: candidate target URI matches existing entry in target set

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Request-URI indicates a resource at this proxy that does not exist, the proxy MUST return a 404 (Not Found) response.
statements.trigger: Request-URI resource does not exist at this proxy

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the target set remains empty after applying all of the above, the proxy MUST return an error response, which SHOULD be the 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response.
statements.trigger: target set remains empty after applying all target determination rules

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the target set remains empty after applying all of the above, the proxy MUST return an error response, which SHOULD be the 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response.
statements.trigger: target set remains empty after applying all target determination rules
actions: Return 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) as the error response
